text: {"schema_version":1,"verdict":"revise","checked":["intent_match","tradeoff_direction","knob_legality"],"critique":"Intent says quiet console/noise => minimize false alarms. Proposed uses transformer w3 default q and persistence 5, but at default threshold persistence 1 false alarms are ~0.01/h; persistence 5 likely further reduces, so intent_match ok. However tradeoff_direction not justified vs capability: for minimizing false alarms you should raise threshold_q and/or persistence; policy only raises persistence. Also knob_legality: threshold_q='default' is allowed, but persistence=5 is allowed; model/window valid. Main issue: no evidence that persistence 5 preserves DNS-type detection; should specify higher threshold_q (e.g., 0.999/0.9999) to meet budget explicitly."}
